plugins_comment: pnpm's node_modules is not the flat tree Stryker scans, so a plugin it is not told about is not found.
related_comment: `vitest --related` picks test files by walking the module graph from the mutated path, which finds nothing in a sandbox. Off, so coverage does the selecting instead.
mutate_comment: Narrow a run with `--mutate <file>`; the mutation workflow builds one job per entry.
coverageAnalysis_comment: Sound only because the property suites are seeded: coverage recorded on one run is reused on the next, which needs a test to reach the same lines both times.
